description: Small, declared section-level retrieval evaluation for material-library step 2c. It measures EmbeddingGemma 2 against a stdlib lexical baseline on one bounded candidate pool from the eight English Siyavula EPUBs. It is an engineering check, not a general benchmark or a production-quality claim.

corpus.note: Candidate passages are extracted from the pinned, unchanged Siyavula EPUBs. Grade labels are South African source grades.

languages.note: Every concept has one English and one Swedish spoken-style question. The Swedish question is sent unchanged to the same encoder and tokenizer; the corpus stays English.

topic_groups.label: Energy and energy transfer (Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology)
Metals and non-metals (Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology)
Electric circuits (Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology)
Refraction, Snell's law and total internal reflection (Grade 11 Physical Sciences)
Quadratic equations and the discriminant (Grade 11 Mathematics)

questions.en: Why do living things need energy from the sun?
questions.sv: Varför behöver levande varelser energi från solen?

concepts.relevance_note: Both sections explain energy for living things and the Sun as its source.

questions.en: How can you tell whether something is a metal or not?
questions.sv: Hur kan man avgöra om något är en metall eller inte?

concepts.relevance_note: The chapter introduction and the property/comparison sections are all reasonable source sections.

questions.en: Why is metal good for making pots and pans?
questions.sv: Varför är metall bra att göra grytor och pannor av?

concepts.relevance_note: Properties of metals covers heat conduction, which is the reason for cooking pots.

questions.en: What makes the bulb light up when you connect it to a battery?
questions.sv: Vad får glödlampan att lysa när man kopplar den till ett batteri?

concepts.relevance_note: The simple circuit and its components explain the closed path and the cell.

questions.en: What is the job of a switch in a circuit?
questions.sv: Vad har en strömbrytare för uppgift i en krets?

concepts.relevance_note: The switch is described as a circuit component that opens and closes the path.

questions.en: How do you draw a circuit so someone else can build the same one?
questions.sv: Hur ritar man en krets så att någon annan kan bygga samma sak?

concepts.relevance_note: Circuit diagrams introduces the drawing conventions and component symbols.

questions.en: Why does a balloon stick to your hair after you rub it?
questions.sv: Varför fastnar en ballong i håret när man gnuggar den?

concepts.relevance_note: Charging by rubbing and charge separation in an insulator explain the sticking.

questions.en: Why do two things with the same charge push each other away?
questions.sv: Varför stöter två saker med samma laddning bort varandra?

concepts.relevance_note: Two kinds of charge and the force between charges state that like charges repel.

questions.en: How big is the charge of a single electron?
questions.sv: Hur stor laddning har en enda elektron?

concepts.relevance_note: Quantisation and the unit of charge give the elementary charge.

questions.en: Why does a pencil look broken when you put it in a glass of water?
questions.sv: Varför ser en penna ut att vara avbruten i ett glas vatten?

concepts.relevance_note: Refraction, optical density and ray diagrams explain the apparent bend.

questions.en: How do you work out the angle when light bends into water?
questions.sv: Hur räknar man ut vinkeln när ljuset böjs in i vatten?

concepts.relevance_note: Snell's law and refractive index are the calculation route.

questions.en: How do you find the sine, cosine and tangent of an angle in a right-angled triangle?
questions.sv: Hur hittar man sinus, cosinus och tangens för en vinkel i en rätvinklig triangel?

concepts.relevance_note: This section defines the three ratios by opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse.

questions.en: How do you rewrite x squared plus six x as a perfect square?
questions.sv: Hur skriver man om x i kvadrat plus sex x som en jämn kvadrat?

concepts.relevance_note: Completing the square is the method the question asks for.

questions.en: How can the discriminant tell you how many solutions an equation has?
questions.sv: Hur kan diskriminanten visa hur många lösningar en ekvation har?

concepts.relevance_note: Nature of roots and the discriminant define the number and type of roots.

questions.en: What does it mean when we say a function gets closer and closer to a limit?
questions.sv: Vad menar man när man säger att en funktion kommer närmare och närmare ett gränsvärde?

concepts.relevance_note: The section and its worked sub-sections define limit behaviour and notation.

questions.en: How do you find the equation of a tangent to a curve at a point?
questions.sv: Hur hittar man ekvationen för en tangent till en kurva i en punkt?

relevant_sections.heading: 6.4 Equation of a tangent to a curve

concepts.relevance_note: This section gives the tangent-line method using the derivative at a point.

questions.en: How does a mobile phone screen show a picture?
questions.sv: Hur visar en mobilskärm en bild?

absent_topics.note: No candidate section and no corpus passage mentions a mobile phone screen or a touch screen.

questions.sv: Hur skickar Wi-Fi data genom luften?

absent_topics.note: The corpus contains no Wi-Fi section; no candidate section is relevant.

questions.en: How do you bake sourdough bread?
questions.sv: Hur bakar man surdegsbröd?

absent_topics.note: No candidate section and no corpus passage mentions sourdough or bread baking.

questions.en: How does a vaccine protect you from a disease?
questions.sv: Hur skyddar ett vaccin mot en sjukdom?

absent_topics.note: No candidate section; the corpus has no vaccine or vaccination passage.
